description: Compare Snap's reported revenue with the revenue your store confirms (read-only). Give store_revenue: what your store credits to Snapchat (for example Shopify or Google Analytics with utm_source=snapchat) for the same days and currency. Window: the last `days` full local days, or start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, both included, up to 31 days). Says whether Snap overstates, understates or is consistent, with both ROAS figures. Optional store_orders adds the store's cost per order.

days.description: How many whole days back to look, counted from the start of today in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

end_date.description: Last day, as YYYY-MM-DD, in the time zone set by SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

start_date.description: First day, as YYYY-MM-DD, in the time zone set by SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

store_orders.description: Your store's number of orders for the same period.

store_revenue.description: Your store's total revenue for the same period, in account currency (from your shop, not from Snap).

name: snap_blended_roas
